### 3. A Preview of DuckDB v2.0

- Source: [duckdb.org](https://duckdb.org/2026/08/17/duckdb-20-highlights.html)
- Category: Tools Worth Testing
- Published: 2026-08-19T00:00:00.000Z
- Labels: vendor_claim, publish_public
- Product relevance: none

Source facts:
- DuckDB v2.0 preview turns the in-process database into an optional server via a CONNECT statement and adds async I/O, triggers, a VARIANT type, a new parser, and a new storage format, targeting a fall release.

Builder/operator takeaway: A well-used solo-dev tool making an architectural change that affects whether local analytics stay local.

Uncertainty: No RC or final release date is set, and the 40x recursive-CTE figure is a single vendor-chosen benchmark.
